No tier-A source found. Re-checked 2026-10-02, and the gap is now narrower but not closed. New this round: open.manus.im/docs is a genuine versioned API reference — an ADR-005 tier-A category — distinguishing API v2 (current) from v1 (deprecated), and it is not labelled Beta. It carries no calendar dates anywhere: no release date for v2, no deprecation date for v1, no last-updated stamps on any page checked. All three Maturity criteria require dates (<= 30 / 31-90 / > 90 days, and a count of stable releases in a trailing 90-day window), and none can be derived from version labels alone. Still 404: manus.im/changelog, manus.im/release-notes, manus.im/help/release-notes, manus.im/docs/api-reference, open.manus.im/docs/changelog. manus.im/updates returns 200 but holds one undated blog link and no dated entries; manus.im/docs/llms.txt indexes the docs and lists no changelog or version-history page; the help-centre root lists eight categories, none of them release notes. The only version-numbered material remains vendor blog copy, which is not evidence under ADR-005.
